title: VoCo: A Simple-yet-Effective Volume Contrastive Learning Framework for 3D Medical Image Analysis
caption: Figure 3. The overall framework of VoCo. VoCo contains a prediction branch and a regularization branch. The prediction branch is responsible for predicting contextual positions between different sub-volumes. The regularization branch is employed to enforce the feature discrepancy between different bases, which aims to learn more discriminative class assignments.
